description: Settings row with description, state and an associated action or control.

howToUse: Use it for each item of a settings page: a preference, a connected account, a session, an API key.
Write the `title` and a short `description`; put the detail (e-mail, date, masked key) in `meta`.
Put the control in `actions` (Switch, Button). Or make the whole row a link with `href`, with no controls inside.
alternatives: A destination card in a list: NavCard.
An integration with connect and disconnect: ConnectorCard.

keyboard.action: Moves to the row, when it is a link, or to its controls.
Opens the row link. Controls keep their own keys.

props.name: meta
props.description: Mono meta under the description (email, IP, date, masked key…).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions on the right (`Button`/`IconButton`/`Badge`/mono text). In a clickable row use only NON-interactive content.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Without `href`, makes the whole row a `<button>`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the clickable row (no click, no Tab focus on the link).

props.name: showChevron
props.description: ">" chevron on the right of clickable rows. Default `true`.

props.name: switchProps
props.description:
`Switch` attached on the right (`.pref-row` pattern). The component links
`aria-labelledby`/`aria-describedby` to the title/description automatically.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

props.name: children
props.description: `SettingRow`s (or any row): each child becomes a `listitem` with a divider.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label of the list (e.g. "Active sessions").

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
